impact: Cannot obtain owner name or a parcel-specific recorded document number for any Riverside parcel through any live channel found this session. Both-sites verification (assessor + recorder tied to the same parcel) cannot be completed even though both the assessor and recorder backends are independently live and real.

observed_behavior: Confirmed live, real API (https://www.sdarcc.gov/bin/cosd/parcel-request?parcelNumber={apn}, HTTP 200, correctly returns an empty array for a non-existent test parcel). The page's own text explicitly states: property ownership information cannot be provided on the internet in accordance with California Government Code section 6254.21 -- the identical statute already documented as Fresno's permanent, technical-fix-proof owner-lookup blocker (CA law removed public lookup Jan 2025). Confirmed no Owner/Assessee field exists anywhere in the site's parcelSearch client JS (only Situs_*, Land_Value, Improvements_Value, Fixtures_value, Personal_property_value, Total_assessed_value, Net_taxable_value, FacBase* fields).
impact: Owner name is not obtainable from San Diego's assessor by any method -- this is a legal restriction, not a technical gap, and will not be fixed by a better connector.
